fixtures.text: The meeting starts at seven thirty tomorrow morning.
fixtures.notes: Smart formatting typically returns the time as 7:30. A naive string comparison fails here; the gate must pass it.

fixtures.text: The store opens at nine o'clock.
fixtures.notes: May come back as 9 o'clock or 9:00 depending on formatting.

fixtures.text: Your train leaves at eight forty five.
fixtures.notes: Two adjacent spoken numbers that mean one clock time.

fixtures.text: Your total comes to twelve dollars and fifty cents.
The invoice was for one thousand two hundred dollars.
fixtures.notes: Smart formatting typically returns $1,200 — a thousands separator the gate must absorb.

fixtures.text: There are one hundred twenty three files in the folder.
Your confirmation number is four two seven nine.
fixtures.notes: An identifier spoken digit by digit; formatting may join it to 4279 or leave it split.

fixtures.text: The package arrives on March third, twenty twenty five.
fixtures.notes: Ordinal day plus a spoken year pair; typically returns March 3rd, 2025.

fixtures.text: The office reopens on Monday, June first.
fixtures.notes: Weekday plus ordinal day; typically returns June 1st or June 1. An earlier wording that began with the word We was genuinely misheard as May — a real recognition error the gate correctly fails, so the fixture was reworded to keep this test on the formatting trap.

fixtures.text: She finished in twenty first place.
The discount comes to fifteen percent.
The company was founded in nineteen ninety nine.
The board measures two point five meters.
Are you free on Friday afternoon?
fixtures.notes: Punctuation-only differences must never fail the gate.

fixtures.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
fixtures.notes: Control fixture with no formatting traps; a failure here indicates a transcription problem, not a formatting one.

fixtures.text: Your appointment on April tenth at nine fifteen will cost forty dollars.
fixtures.notes: Several trap classes in one sentence — the closest fixture to real voice-agent output.
